purpose: Diagnose the attempt-5 path-argument mismatch by constraining each named tool path parameter to its one fixture-safe path; validate whether the pinned TP=2 server can complete the same read→write loop.
controlledDifferenceFromAttempt05: Add JSON Schema enum constraints path=[source.txt] for read_file and path=[result.txt] for write_file. passCriteria: exactly one read_file call with valid call id and pathMatchesContract=true
exactly one write_file call with valid call id, pathMatchesContract=true and contentMatchesFixture=true
